text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the Takarazuka Kinen now behind her, Silence Suzuka buckles down for her goal race—the autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But until then, she spends her days training in preparation for her next race—the Mainichi Okan.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasa and Grass Wonder eagerly wait for their chance to race against Silence Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They issue their challenge and promise to meet her at the starting gates of the Mainichi Okan.
